answer: When an agent joins, it must solve a proof‑of‑work puzzle whose target difficulty Δ (delta) is recomputed each block as a function of the rolling count of new registrations; the algorithm treats each burst of sign‑ups like water flowing through a karst cave, steepening the hash threshold exponentially. The solver must commit an ivory‑valued stake equal to 2ⁿ tokens, where n is the number of registrations in the preceding epoch, and broadcast the nonce and stake receipt.
